objective: Factorize the immediate AdamW--Muon functional difference into singular-vector-basis and singular-value-spectrum effects, then localize any spectrum effect to head, middle, or tail bands.

anchor_scope.rationale: Use the entire already-frozen anchor grid; do not select checkpoints from observed intervention outcomes.

factorization.basis_definition: left and right singular vectors of the named source direction

band_boundaries.rounding: nearest integer boundaries with complete disjoint coverage

tail_protocol.tail_selection: largest per-query contrastive-loss change from the unmodified anchor, selected independently for AdamW native and every challenger condition
tail_protocol.primary_factorial_readout: Compare Adam-basis/Muon-spectrum and Muon-basis/Adam-spectrum against AdamW native. Tail protection follows the spectrum only if the former improves loss p95 and margin p05 more consistently across anchors than the latter.
tail_protocol.symmetric_tail_readout: Report challenger-minus-AdamW loss contrast on AdamW's worst tail and on the challenger's independently selected worst tail, plus tail-set Jaccard overlap.
tail_protocol.architecture_readout: Compare DenseOn tail redistribution with LateOn shared-tail severity suppression without pooling architectures.

primary_estimands: Within the AdamW singular-vector basis, the paired change in positive-margin effect as lambda moves from 0 to 1.
The 2x2 spectrum-by-basis interaction formed by AdamW native, Muon native, Adam-basis/Muon-spectrum, and Muon-basis/Adam-spectrum directions.
The separate paired effects of transplanting the head, middle, and tail Muon singular-value bands into the AdamW basis.
Whether the query-level adverse tail follows the Muon singular-value spectrum or the Muon singular-vector basis under the frozen symmetric-tail rule.

freeze_context.note: This explanatory intervention was designed after observing the local-to-global reversal and is not a preregistered discovery test. No spectral-transplant output existed at freeze time.

amendments.reason: Freeze query-tail estimands motivated by the already-visible functional tail result before any spectrum/basis transplant outcome exists; leave the intervention conditions and claim boundary unchanged.

claim_boundary: This intervention can causally attribute immediate fixed-state functional differences to singular values versus singular vectors. It cannot alone show that the attributed component causes a full-training BEIR gain; that requires the independently frozen shared-start branches or a later explicitly disclosed spectral-operator branch.
